clauses.instruction: Acquire the authorized sandbox security mock-data scan needed to inspect the workspace for review targets.
Project the attested targets array from the acquired workspace scan.
Project the attested target identifier array from the acquired workspace scan.
Summarize the concrete security mock-data targets needing review, using the acquired target records and target identifiers without adding unobserved targets.

clauses.instruction: Derive the task-explicit target identifier for the requested routine mock security-access action.
Apply the task-requested routine mock security-access action to the explicit target for the general review.

Derive the task-bounded target id for the scanned item that appears relevant to active team work and therefore matches the requested collaboration-access adjustment.

Derive the task-requested access-update intent as creating shareable access for the discovered private incident notes folders, without adding any unrequested detail field value.
Create the task-requested shareable access for the scanner-discovered private incident notes folders target using the security access manager.
